headline: 49ers vs Rams Thursday Night Football: NFC West duel opens NFL Week 4 tonight
whyCareReason: Division rivals collide on short rest in Santa Clara as Brock Purdy and Matthew Stafford open NFL Week 4 in prime time.
teaser: Thursday night at Levi's Stadium (8:15 p.m. ET / 5:15 p.m. PT). Brock Purdy and Christian McCaffrey host Matthew Stafford and Kyren Williams as Week 4 kicks off.
story:
Why this one matters: Following Philadelphia's tight 24-20 Monday Night Football win over Dallas, the NFL turns directly to an NFC West grudge match under the Thursday night lights in Santa Clara.

San Francisco welcomes the Los Angeles Rams to Levi's Stadium for the first domestic meeting of the campaign, eager to defend home territory on short rest. Brock Purdy and Christian McCaffrey anchor a 49ers offense seeking to establish early division leverage, while Kyle Shanahan's defensive front prepares for Sean McVay's dynamic passing scheme.

For Matthew Stafford and the Rams, Thursday night provides an immediate chance to level the season series following their Week 1 clash in Melbourne. With both teams dealing with the physical strain of short-week preparation, every third-down execution will define the night.
stakes: Divisional supremacy in the NFC West and early tiebreaker leverage ahead of the October grind.
rivalryAngle: One of the NFL's oldest and fiercest rivalries, renewed on short rest in front of a national audience.
